title: sign() P-521 docstring wrong; workaround comment produces broken messages
description: sign.rs docstring says 'EC P-521 uses SHA-512' but signature_algorithm_oid() rejects DigestAlgorithm::Sha512 for EC keys with UnsupportedAlgorithm. More importantly, the comment at sign.rs:292 says 'Callers using P-521 keys must override preferred_digest_algorithm() to return Sha384' — this workaround is broken: signing with P-521 key + SHA-384 produces OID ECDSA_WITH_SHA_384, but verify() dispatches that OID to verify_ecdsa_p384() which tries to parse the P-521 public key as a P-384 key and fails. The workaround creates sign/verify-incompatible messages. The correct guidance is: P-521 is unsupported — use P-256 or P-384.
